title: The IRL ASMR Ghost Story Audiobook of my spooky season DREAMS! @Audib...
transcript: Have you ever wanted to be inside of a Ghost Story audiobook? Well, you can now do that in New York City at Audible Theaters. A ghost in your ear, A first of its kind headphone horror show. You heard me right. You wear headphones the entire show while you watch Lucas Iverson from HBO's The Pit and Owen Campbell from a 24th X record. A Ghost Story that may or may not be actually happening to them in the record Ring studio. It's truly one of the coolest experiences I've ever had in New York City. And not only that, but the show itself is beyond. It's like an ASMR ghost story TikTok brought to life in front of you, but also in your literal ears. Get your tickets soon, because this intimate theater experience is coming straight from a sold out London run, and it's the perfect spooky season activity. Prepare to jump. Prepare to scream. I did, like five times. And prepare to have a theater experience like you've never seen or heard before. See it if you dare.
classificationReason: Creator attended the production, describes the experience first-hand with clear personal opinion and recommendation ('one of the coolest experiences I've ever had', 'I did, like five times').
